messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: RStan 2.1.1 corrects issue with Rcpp 0.11.0
parts:
We've just released a new version of RStan to deal
with an issue arising in Rcpp 0.11.0; you should only
need this release if you have upgraded to Rcpp 0.11.0.

As usual, you can find the latest version of RStan along with
install instructions at:

https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan/wiki/RStan-Getting-Started

- RStan Dev Team
